newsitem.title: USA: AT&T names McGovern as consumer division head.
newsitem.headline: AT&T names McGovern as consumer division head.

text.p: AT&T Corp said Sunday it had appointed Gail McGovern as executive vice president of its consumer and small business division.

The company said McGovern, who served as executive vice president of the business markets division, will replace Joseph Nacchio, who is leaving AT&T to become president and chief executive officer of Qwest Communications Corp in Denver.
Jeffrey Weitzen, vice president and general manager of Global Services business, will succeed McGovern in her former post, it added.
